Our speciality

Birding in the Western Ghats

Early starts, quiet walking and guides who know where the forest edge, plantation and wetland species show up. Bring binoculars if you have them; we can help with the rest.

DawnBest activity window
Small groupsQuieter, better sightings
All levelsFirst-timers to listers

Species seen vary by season and luck. We never promise a sighting.

Evenings

Kerala after dark

Slow down once the forest closes for the day. Watch a Kathakali performer apply make-up, see Kalaripayattu, one of the world's oldest martial arts, or settle into an Ayurvedic massage.

Plan your visit

Visit responsibly

Getting here

Thekkady is about 4 hours by road from Kochi and Madurai. We can arrange pick-up and local transfers.

Wildlife welfare

We keep distance from animals and choose elephant experiences that don't involve riding or chaining. Ask us what's on offer.

Permits and rulesPeriyar Tiger Reserve activities need advance permits that are issued by Kerala Forest Department or KFDC. We help with bookings, but availability and fees are theirs to set.
